messages:
Maria Chen: planning to push runtime:v2.3.0-quant-matmul to canary tonight during late window (23:00-01:00 PST). need pin strategy and explicit rollback criteria.
Dan Kim: ack. is this the build with the new matmul tiling + kernel ABI tweaks?
Maria Chen: yes. tiling + small abi change for kv-cache layout. ran unit perf locally, looks fine but want ops signoff.
Ravi Patel: two quick asks: 1) keep a sticky-pin on the previous runtime image for 2 hours after traffic shift, 2) telemetry gating on p50 p95 and error-rate.
Jen Owens: +1. add a canary slice: 1% global, 5% in staging-regions, then 25% after 10m if signals look good.
Sam R: also add a matmul microbench smoke that runs on canary nodes (from ci/inference/smoke_matmul.sh). if that fails, auto-pin.
deploy-bot: scheduled deploy queued by @Maria Chen for 2026-04-02 23:15 PST -> runtime:v2.3.0-quant-matmul (canary). command: ```/deploy runtime canary --image=runtime:v2.3.0-quant-matmul --slice=1% --monitor=telemetry:matmul_smoke```
Maria Chen: proposed rollback triggers (draft):
- if canary p50 latency increases >20% vs baseline for 5m
- if p95 latency increases >15% for 10m
- if error-rate (inference 5xx) >0.3% sustained 5m
- if matmul smoke fails on >10% of canary instances
Dan Kim: sounds reasonable. add one more: memory growth on nodes >200MB over baseline for 15m (possible leak).
Ravi Patel: update: we should pin image in routing for control-plane fallback. fallback plan: routing fallback -> runtime:v2.2.8-stable. Do not roll forward until root cause triaged.
Jen Owens: release notes draft for docs: "runtime v2.3.0-quant-matmul: optimized matmul tiling for faster short-sequence inference; small ABI change to KV-cache for reduced memory churn; expect ~10-18% p50 improvement on chat workloads. See migration notes for pinning and compatibility."
Maria Chen: thanks. can someone own post-deploy heatmap collection and a quick slack summary at +30m/+2h?
Sam R: I can do +30m. Ravi take +2h?
Ravi Patel: yep i'll do +2h and trigger rollback if criteria hit.
ops-bot: NOTE: late window approvals required from eng-sre. Maria, please confirm eng-sre ack before 22:45 PST.
Maria Chen: pinging @Dan Kim for eng-sre ack.
Dan Kim: eng-sre acked verbally, i'll post the formal approval in channel at 22:40. one more: include a deploy tag in routing metadata so we can filter traces: tag=matmul-q2-nightly.
deploy-bot: preflight checks passed (binaries signed, checksum ok). smoke job queued.
deploy-bot: canary rollout started at 23:15 PST -> 1% traffic.
Sam R: smoke results: 8/8 nodes OK, matmul microbench latency within baseline. posting brief metrics link: https://telemetry.redwood/internal/shot/abcd1234
Maria Chen: increasing to 5% now per plan. monitoring p50/p95 and mem.
Sam R: at +12m p50 +4%, p95 +6%, errors 0.02%, mem delta +40MB. good so far.
Ravi Patel: at +40m asserting check: p95 spike to +18% for 3m, but error-rate stable and mem okay. still below rollback thresholds. watching.
Jen Owens: recommend wait another 10m before 25% cut. we have hysteresis on short spikes.
Maria Chen: agreed, hold.
Ravi Patel: at +55m p95 back to +7%. going to proceed to 25% per plan in 5m.
deploy-bot: traffic shifted to 25% at 00:20 PST.
Sam R: collecting heatmap snapshot and leaving note for docs.
Maria Chen: thanks all. if anything changes call out immediate rollback. otherwise i'll draft release note and pin instructions and post in #release-notes tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
Dan Kim: nice coordinated run.
ops-bot: deploy complete. final image pinned in routing metadata: runtime:v2.3.0-quant-matmul. roll-forward disabled for 2h.
Maria Chen: closing thread, moving post-mortem if any regressions.
